export const OTPMailTemplate = (otp: string): string => { return ` OTP Verification
NoteFlow
Verify your email
Use the following One-Time Password (OTP) to complete your verification. This code is valid for a limited time.
Your verification code is:
${String(otp).split("").join(" ")}
For your security, do not share this code with anyone.
This code will expire in 5 minutes.
If you did not request this, you can safely ignore this email.
`; }; export const resetPasswordMailTemplate = (resetLink: string): string => { return ` Reset Password
NoteFlow
Reset your password
We received a request to reset your password. Click the button below to set a new password.
Reset Password
If the button doesn’t work, copy and paste this link into your browser:
${resetLink}
For security reasons, this link will expire in 5 minutes.
If you did not request a password reset, you can safely ignore this email.
This link is valid for one-time use only.
`; };
